content:
Maya: Kicking off Crow LoRA + quant smoke on dev pool. pack: crow_quick_v4 (160 prompts) focusing invoices/currency/ref tokens.
Priya: Going int4 primary, then int8 as fallback. Will run symmetric and asymmetric.
Omar: Add edgecases: `INV#A-000`, `acct:00-12`, `£1,234.50.` (trailing dot) — they split weirdly.
Maya: Added edgecases to evals/crow/edgecases_v4.csv and marked in the pack.
Dev: Small dry run log: ```[2024-11-05T06:12:10Z] load ok; quant int4 asym; WARN qkv-shape x2; warmup done```.
Dev: qkv warnings visible but no crash.
Priya: Quick metrics: EM_fp16=94.1%, EM_int4=91.0%. Halluc_rate fp16=3.0%, int4=5.0%. latency_int4 ~54ms, fp16 ~108ms.
Maya: Uploaded diff: https://redwood.internal/evals/4976543210/crow-int4-diff.html — top mismatches look token-splitting heavy.
Omar: Triage: of top20 fails -> 13 tokenization, 4 ctx truncation, 3 generation regression.
Priya: For the 3 regressions we should set per-route fallback to fp16 for invoice-extractors.
Maya: Done. Routing rule: crow/invoice -> prefer fp16; others try int4 with fallback.
infra-bot: eval-run complete: mean_latency_int4=52ms; mean_latency_fp16=110ms; cost_ratio int4/fp16=0.39
Omar: Next: try symmetric quant + per-channel scale and disable qkv-fusion. Also test tokenizer normalization preserving `INV#...`.
Priya: I'll draft a short note for CS with rollout recommendation: canary 10% non-critical routes, critical parsers pinned to fp16 until fixes.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: crow_quick_v4 -> 10% at 2024-11-07T09:00:00Z
Maya: Closing after symmetric quant re-run + tokenizer patch results. :thumbsup:
